tasks.description: Look at the cartoon and read its text.

questions.text: What does the cartoonist warn people about?
answers: A: The cartoonist warns people about making expensive Internet calls
B: The cartoonist warns people about chatting with unknown people
C: The cartoonist warns people about looking for new friends online
D: The cartoonist warns people about putting private data on the Internet
